disclaimer: Official Meridian simulated/demo data (and any legacy dummy data) only. Metrics and Meridian artifacts are not estimates of real campaign performance.

data.notes: national weekly series; truncated train context to last 100 rows

deliverables.expected_outcome: holdout KPI predictions via TabFMRegressor (predictive only)
deliverables.geo_insights: Row-level geo-week prediction possible if geo panel features are supplied; no Meridian hierarchical geo posteriors.
deliverables.honesty: TabFM is a tabular ICL regressor, not an MMM. Only predictive KPI is a Yes; other Meridian deliverables are Partial/No — see deliverables matrix.

extras.note: Minimal Meridian MCMC PoC. Holdout KPI uses in-sample expected_outcome on later weeks (fit on full series).

budget_optimization.note: Use meridian.analysis.optimizer in a full Meridian workflow; skipped here for PoC runtime.

geo_insights.note: National model — no geo-level Meridian insights in this run.

deliverables_matrix.how_meridian_produces_it: Analyzer.expected_outcome / predictive_accuracy — Bayesian posterior expected KPI given media, controls, and model structure (adstock, Hill, etc.).
deliverables_matrix.tabfm_notes: TabFMRegressor can predict a continuous KPI from tabular media/control features via ICL. Comparable only as a predictive score (RMSE/MAE/R²), not as a structural MMM fit.

deliverables_matrix.how_meridian_produces_it: Analyzer.incremental_outcome — counterfactual E(Y|treatment) − E(Y|no treatment) under the fitted Bayesian MMM.
deliverables_matrix.tabfm_notes: No native incremental contribution. Optional leave-one-channel ablation on predictions is a hacky sensitivity proxy — NOT Meridian-equivalent and not causal.

deliverables_matrix.how_meridian_produces_it: Analyzer.roi / summary_metrics — incremental outcome ÷ spend with posterior uncertainty.
deliverables_matrix.tabfm_notes: TabFM has no spend→outcome structural ROI. Dividing ablation deltas by spend would be misleading and is not implemented as a Meridian-equivalent deliverable.

deliverables_matrix.how_meridian_produces_it: Analyzer.response_curves — Hill/saturation response under historical flighting with spend multipliers.
deliverables_matrix.tabfm_notes: Zero-shot tabular regression has no adstock/Hill media transform or native response-curve API.

deliverables_matrix.how_meridian_produces_it: meridian.analysis.optimizer — allocate budget under response curves / ROI constraints.
deliverables_matrix.tabfm_notes: No optimizer. Any grid-search over TabFM predictions would be an ad-hoc experiment, not Meridian budget optimization.

deliverables_matrix.how_meridian_produces_it: Geo hierarchical Meridian model + Analyzer with selected_geos / geo aggregation flags.
deliverables_matrix.tabfm_notes: TabFM can take geo-week rows as tabular features and predict KPI per row, but it does not provide hierarchical geo shrinkage, geo ROI, or Meridian geo posteriors.

deliverables_capability_summary.headline: TabFM can match Meridian on predictive KPI scoring only. Contribution/ROI/response curves/budget optimization are MMM-structural and are not native TabFM deliverables.
